text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With the end of the year approaching, Landosol is in a somewhat festive mood. That feeling is no different even here at the guildhouse of the Gourmet Guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一年の終わりを前に、どこか浮足立った雰囲気のランドソル。
それはここ【美食殿】でも変わらない。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Alright-o! That marks the end of our big cleaning operation!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
っと！
これで大掃除はおしまいね！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work, My Lord. The dirt from the past year has been cleaned up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
主さまもおつかれさまでございます。
一年の汚れも
きれいになりました。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now we can all welcome the new year with a clear mind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！　
これですっきりした気持ちで新年を迎えられますね！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Even the backs of shelves and under the bed, which are spots usually invisible to the eye, are sparkling clean. ...So this is what a big cleaning end result is like...
text_block_list.orig_text:
普段は見えない
棚の裏やベッドの下も、
ピカピカになったわね。
……これが
大掃除なのね……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: We put a lot of effort into these kinds of annual events, so it's no wonder you'd be surprised. After all, this is your first New Year's Eve at the Gourmet Guild, Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちってば
こういう年中行事みたいなのにはやたら手間かけるからね～
シェフィにとっては【美食殿】での初めての年越しだし、
驚くのも無理ないか。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Hah! Now that I think about it, you're right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！　
確かにそうですね！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Since you were helping us out so naturally, I didn't even notice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
自然にお手伝いしていただいておりましたので
気が付きませんでした……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I've heard about this holiday from the people of the city. But I didn't want to bother everyone by bombarding you all with too many questions...
text_block_list.orig_text:
街の人たちに聞いたりして
おおまかな知識はあったから。
でも、
あまり質問攻めにして、
みんなに迷惑かけちゃいけないと思ってたし……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: A bother, there's no way that'd the case! We're good friends living under the same roof, aren't we?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
迷惑なんてそんな！
わたしたちの仲じゃないですか！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: That's exactly right. And this isn't solely about the big cleaning itself. Please allow us to teach you more about every step.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでございます。
大掃除のことだけではなく、
もっとわたくしたちに
手取り足取り
教えさせてくださいませ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Sheffy-chan's first New Year's Eve at the Gourmet Guild... we'll all make sure to make it the very best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィちゃんの【美食殿】での初めてのお正月……
最高のものにしちゃいますよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes. Leave it to us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
わたくしたちにお任せください。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... You guys. Don't be bothering Sheffy with all that consideration now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
あんたたちねえ。
あんまりシェフィを困らせるんじゃないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's not a bother, really. I'm very happy to hear that, actually.
text_block_list.orig_text:
困ってはないわよ。
そう言ってもらえるのは
とってもうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Sheffy, you really are too honest to a fault. Whenever Pecorine starts some grand declaration like that, it usually ends up turning into some food-related business...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィ、
あんたって本当に素直すぎ。
ペコリーヌがこういう
なんかいいことっぽいことを言うときは
だいたい食べ物関係の裏が……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We're going to have a New Year's party featuring all kinds of dishes!
text_block_list.orig_text: おせちパーティーをしますよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: New Year's dishes...? You mean those that are part of an osechi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おせちって……
おせち料理のこと？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes. New Year's dishes are those that you eat together with everyone at the same table.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
お正月にみんなで食べる
お料理のことでございます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: See, what did I tell you? It ended up being related to food as always...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらね？
すーぐ食べ物につなげるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's because... we're the Gourmets! Are you against our mission, Kyaru?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってそれが
【美食殿】ですから！
キャルちゃんは反対ですか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It's not like that's my intention, but... You haven't forgotten about last year, have you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
別にそういうわけじゃないけど……
去年のこと、
忘れてないでしょうね？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Last year... Ah, you must be referring to the Tunnus from Oma!
text_block_list.orig_text:
去年のこと……
オーマのトゥンヌスですね！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes, it was very delicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
大変美味しゅうございました。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... Wait, it was certainly delicious, but that's not it! I'm talking about the money we spent! Expenses! Costs!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん……
って、
そりゃ確かに美味しかったけど
そうじゃなくて！
お金の話よ！　
費用！　
コスト！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: If we hadn't spent so much money having fun at our year's end party, we wouldn't have needed to go to Oma in the first place. We went there because we had to, and in the end that shitty glasses even ended up making use of us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
忘年会であんなに豪遊しなきゃ
そもそもオーマに行く必要なかったじゃないの。
行ったら行ったで、
結局あのクソ眼鏡にいいように使われちゃったし。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: But thanks to that, we were able to spend a beautiful New Year's with everyone we also met at our stay in Oma, Lady Kyaru.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
そのおかげでオーマのみなさまと
素晴らしいお正月を過ごせたではありませんか、
キャルさま。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You're always leaving out the reckless part of the adventure! Anyway, I want this year to be planned out to the detail. Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつも無茶ぶりし過ぎなのよね～！
とにかく、
今年は計画的にいくわよ。
いいわね？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chan if you're so intent on saying so, we'll all be a little more careful♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルちゃんがそう言うなら
少し気を付けますね♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: A little isn't enough, be WAY MORE careful here!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 少しじゃなくてしっかり気を付けなさいよ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Well, to be fair it was fine as it was. Oma's seafood was the best. Oh, that's right! Let's buy the ingredients for the New Year's feast at Oma too. We're not strangers to them, so maybe we can get a discount if we buy in bulk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まあ、
あれはあれでよかったけどね。
オーマの魚介は最高だったし。
あ、
そうだ！　
おせちの材料も
オーマで買っちゃいましょうよ。
知らない仲じゃないし、
まとめて買えば安くしてもらえるかも！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: The food at the Guild Race Victory Celebration we had the New Year before then was also wonderful, with auspicious decorations fitting for the celebration.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その前のお正月にいただいた、
ギルドレース祝勝会でのお料理も
お正月らしく
縁起のいい飾りつけで素敵でございました。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, speaking of the tradition of osechi, apparently it hails from the land of Togoku. Why don't we all go there shopping together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
おせちと言えば
本場はトーゴクらしいですし
いっそのこと
みんなでトーゴクまで
買い出しにいっちゃいましょうか！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I've just been telling you NOT TO waste money on expensive and random ideas like those!
text_block_list.orig_text: だからそういう思い付きで無駄遣いするなって言ってんのよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...
text_block_list.orig_text: ふふっ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing. It seems that everyone here truly has their own share of New Year's memories by now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
なんでもないわ。
みんな
いろんな正月の思い出があるんだな
って……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: If you're so worried about money, how about we build up the osechi by using monster food?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お金の問題なら
魔物料理のおせちにするのはどうですか？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that is certainly a good idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
確かに名案でございます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What the hell are you two even thinking of using monsters as main courses for a celebrative feast?! Hey, Sheffy! Try to put some salt in their heads too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたち
こんな時にまで魔物料理ってなによ！
ちょっとシェフィ！　
あんたからもなんか言ってやりなさいよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me? Certainly, if it was just monster cooking on the table I don't think it'd be appropriate...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
私？
確かに、
魔物料理だけだと
ちょっと困るけど……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: As I've said, Oma and its fish food! That's a fine menu, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーマで魚よ！
それでいいでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: I would love for Lady Sheffy to try the food made with auspicious items like the one from the victory celebration from back then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
祝勝会の時の縁起物を使ったお料理を、
ぜひシェフィさまにも味わっていただきたいです。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's right! Kyaru-chan, if you're really after fish this time, why don't we try out that place we went back during summer where we had a Tentapass BBQ?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！　
キャルちゃん、
お魚さんが好きなら
以前
テンタパスバーベキューをした海岸に行きませんか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Tentapass BBQ... THAT'S JUST ANOTHER MONSTER FOOD THEMED IDEA! I've already told you that I want this holiday to be monster food free!
text_block_list.orig_text:
テンタパスバーベキューって
魔物バーベキューじゃないの！
魔物じゃないのも食べたいって言ってるのよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: In that case... Since this is meant to be an osechi, how about we try gathering each of those dishes from every place you mentioned? Like the fish Kyaru was talking about, the auspicious themed food from the victory celebration and the ingredient from that barbecue of yours... how about it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だったら……
おせちの材料、
さっきみんなが話していた
オーマの魚や
祝勝会の縁起物や
バーベキューの時の食材を
いろんな場所で集めてみる、
とか？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That works!
text_block_list.orig_text: それです！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: That's fine by me!
text_block_list.orig_text: それでございます！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's it!
text_block_list.orig_text: それよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That really works for you all?
text_block_list.orig_text: それでいいの？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Putting all three of our opinions together is not a bad idea at all. It avoids this holiday turning into some monster food nonsense in its entirety. I have no complaints.
text_block_list.orig_text:
３人の意見をまとめた良いアイデアじゃない。
それだと
魔物おせちってわけじゃないし。
あたしは文句なんてないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Sheffy, that's a great idea. This is a good opportunity for you to learn more about the history of the Gourmet Guild too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさま、
名案でございます。
これまでの【美食殿】のことをもっと知っていただく
いい機会ではないでしょうか。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We'll call it: "Gourmet Guild: New Year's Memories Operation"! Eating an osechi is equivalent to a good luck charm after all... First, let's head to the city to prepare!
text_block_list.orig_text:
名付けて
『【美食殿】
思い出おせち作戦』
ですね！
おせちといえば縁起物……
まずは準備のために街へ向かいますよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With that single command from Pecorine, the Gourmet Guild party made their way to the shopping district of Landosol and arrived in front of a certain shop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌの一声でランドソルの繁華街に繰り出した【美食殿】一行は、
とある店の前へやって来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... The four of us have some specific preparations to handle, so wait for us out here, {0}-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ……
わたしたちはちょっと準備がありますので
{0}くんはここで待っていてくださいね！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: My deepest apologies, My Lord. I'll be right back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
申し訳ございません、
主さま。
すぐに戻りますので。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...I'd feel bad for making him wait out here alone. I'll wait too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人で待たせるなんて悪いわ。
私もこっちにいるわね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Noooooo. Come with us, Sheffy. {0}, you too, don't just wander around out here and wait for us. Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダーメ。
シェフィはあたしたちと来なさい？
あんたも
フラフラしないで待ってるのよ。
いいわね？

text_block_list.text: Oh my? Is that you, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや？
そこにいるのは
{0}かい？
